en.headline: Underground cable sparks and smoke force response on Pei Ho Street
en.dek: Firefighters attended reports of smoke and several loud bangs from manhole covers near vegetable stalls in Sham Shui Po on Wednesday morning; no one was injured and nearby shops temporarily lost power.
body: Firefighters responded shortly after 10:30 a.m. on Wednesday to reports of smoke and multiple explosion-like sounds coming from manhole covers on Pei Ho Street in Sham Shui Po.

Officers found two to three covers between vegetable stalls emitting smoke, believed to be linked to an underground cable. Firefighters used a hose and breathing apparatus to cool the area. No injuries were reported and no evacuation was required.
CLP Power staff attended the scene to investigate. Some nearby shops temporarily lost electricity. Residents said a burning smell had been noticeable in the area for about a week before the incident.

zh.headline: 深水埗北河街渠蓋冒煙傳爆炸聲 疑地底電纜肇事
zh.dek: 周三早上約10時半，深水埗北河街菜檔附近渠蓋冒煙並傳出多次巨響，消防射水降溫，無人受傷，附近部分商舖一度停電。
body: 消防處周三早上約10時31分接報，指深水埗北河街109號附近有渠蓋冒煙，並一度傳出多次爆炸聲，多人報案。
消防人員到場發現兩個菜檔之間的兩至三個渠蓋冒煙，估計與地底電纜有關，遂出動喉及煙帽隊射水降溫。事件中無人受傷，亦毋須疏散。
中電人員到場調查，受影響範圍部分商舖一度停電。有街坊表示，事發前約一周附近已傳出燒焦氣味，並有渠蓋不時噴煙。
